body: [{"streamId":"01a1f445-e114-7439-a8ba-202fd73a407f","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskRevised","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1f445-e114-7439-a8ba-202fd73a407f\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022For every session, confined or not, the tool guard judges the path of a Read, Edit, Write, Glob, or Grep call with its \\u0060.\\u0060 and \\u0060..\\u0060 collapsed by name before any symbolic link is followed, as the Claude Code CLI opens it, so a \\u0060..\\u0060 written after a link can no longer make the guard decide on a different place than the one the call reaches.\u0022},\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:[\u0022In a session that is not confined, on macOS and Linux, a Read, Edit, or Write whose file path, a Grep whose path, and a Glob whose path or pattern climbs with \\u0060..\\u0060 back out of a symbolic link is refused whenever that path, read with \\u0060.\\u0060 and \\u0060..\\u0060 collapsed by name before any link is followed, is in or contains the node home or a protected Claude Code config directory, even when the same path with the link followed first lands inside the work directory. New tests in \\u0060tests/Coanda.Tests/Daemon/Executors/ToolGuardTests.cs\\u0060 show this for each of Read, Edit, Write, Grep\\u0027s path, Glob\\u0027s path, and Glob\\u0027s pattern against the node home, and for at least one of them against a config directory, returning early where links cannot be created, as the existing link tests there do.\u0022,\u0022In a session that is not confined, a call whose path collapsed that way lands outside the work directory but neither in nor around the node home or a config directory is still allowed, and a new test in \\u0060ToolGuardTests.cs\\u0060 shows one such call allowed, so the fix gives an unconfined session no confined session\\u0027s limit to its work directory.\u0022,\u0022Every test in \\u0060ToolGuardTests.cs\\u0060 and \\u0060ConfinedSessionTests.cs\\u0060 that exists on \\u0060main\\u0060 when the work starts passes without being edited, so no call the guard refuses today becomes allowed and a confined session\\u0027s refusals are unchanged.\u0022,\u0022\\u0060docs/node-configuration.md\\u0060 and the remarks on the \\u0060ToolGuard\\u0060 class say that for every session, not only a confined one, a file tool\\u0027s path is judged with \\u0060.\\u0060 and \\u0060..\\u0060 collapsed by name before links are followed, and the docs no longer present that reading as a rule of confined sessions alone.\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022## Where this came from\\n\\nA pre-PR adversarial review of the confinement task\\u0027s diff found this in code that diff did not touch and routed it here as out of scope. The defect was re-read and confirmed against commit 8ebc34b4.\\n\\n## What is wrong\\n\\n\\u0060ToolGuard.Decide\\u0060 (\\u0060src/Coanda.Daemon/Executors/ClaudeCode/ToolGuard.cs\\u0060) builds the paths it judges for a Read, Edit, or Write (line 130 at commit 8ebc34b4), a Grep, and a Glob, and resolves each with \\u0060GuardPath.Resolve\\u0060, which on macOS and Linux walks the components one at a time and follows a link before it applies a later \\u0060..\\u0060 (\\u0060GuardPath.cs\\u0060, \\u0060Real\\u0060). The Claude Code CLI collapses \\u0060.\\u0060 and \\u0060..\\u0060 by name first and opens the result. The guard also judges a path that second way, through the local \\u0060Opened\\u0060 function and \\u0060Named.Collapsed\\u0060 (which \\u0060Judge.Refusal\\u0060 resolves with \\u0060GuardPath.Collapsed\\u0060), but only when \\u0060rules.Confined\\u0060 is true (line 149). An unconfined session\\u0027s file-tool path is therefore judged only the operating system\\u0027s way, so for a path that climbs back out of a link the guard can judge one place while the CLI opens another.\\n\\nOn Windows \\u0060GuardPath.Real\\u0060 already makes the path full, collapsing \\u0060..\\u0060 by name, before it follows any link, so the mismatch is on macOS and Linux only.\\n\\nBash is not part of this: a shell does follow links before a later \\u0060..\\u0060 in the paths it hands a program, so its words stay judged as they are.\\n\\n## Why this is blocked\\n\\nThe task this one is blocked by makes the guard read a file tool\\u0027s path as the CLI opens it for every session (its concern is \\u0060$NAME\\u0060 substitution) and edits the same lines, including the \\u0060rules.Confined\\u0060 condition. Its likely fix, dropping that condition, would also run the collapsed reading for unconfined sessions and may end this defect as a side effect, although that task lists the link mismatch as a non-goal. This task starts from \\u0060main\\u0060 after that pull request merges: if the merged code already judges an unconfined session\\u0027s path collapsed first, this task adds the tests and the docs sentence and nothing else; if not, it extends that reading to unconfined sessions. It is blocked rather than stacked because it needs nothing from that branch before merge; waiting only avoids a second, conflicting edit of the same lines.\\n\\n## Hints, not requirements\\n\\n- The smallest fix is to judge every session\\u0027s file-tool paths both ways, as a confined session\\u0027s are today. \\u0060Judge.Refusal(string)\\u0060 already refuses an unconfined path only when it reaches the node home or a config directory, so the added reading needs no confined-only logic to satisfy the second criterion.\\n- The existing test \\u0060A_confined_path_climbing_back_out_of_a_symbolic_link_is_judged_as_the_cli_collapses_it_first\\u0060 in \\u0060ToolGuardTests.cs\\u0060 shows the link set-up and the Windows early return to copy.\\n- \\u0060docs/node-configuration.md\\u0060 describes the confined reading in the bullet beginning \\u0022Each such path is also judged the way Claude Code itself opens it\\u0022, under \\u0022What a confined session may reach\\u0022, and the general guard paragraph above it says only that the guard resolves links before it compares.\\n\\n## Non-goals\\n\\n- No change to how Bash commands are read, to which tools are guarded, or to what a confined session may reach.\\n- No change to \\u0060$NAME\\u0060 handling in a file tool\\u0027s path; that is the blocking task\\u0027s.\u0022},\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Type\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022Bugfix\u0022},\u0022Model\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RevisedAt\u0022:\u00222026-11-20T14:57:46.16768\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022RevisedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022EpicId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u002201a1f0ea-ad6d-7319-a7f2-f3eb0cb13a12\u0022},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Constraints\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Effort\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022HumanGate\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RefinementSessionId\u0022:\u002201a1f973-a2b8-70f9-b9a9-5ee233014863\u0022,\u0022FeedbackStep\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"2dc29cb3-0146-4b96-8f19-ade218d52162","originSequence":232024,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-11-20T14:57:46.233593+00:00","originProjectId":"01a1a29e-778a-7730-9f07-304d9ac0ffeb"},{"streamId":"01a1f445-e114-7439-a8ba-202fd73a407f","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.PublicationTokensRecorded","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1f445-e114-7439-a8ba-202fd73a407f\u0022,\u0022InputTokens\u0022:32,\u0022OutputTokens\u0022:12862,\u0022CostUsd\u0022:0.8671396,\u0022RecordedAt\u0022:\u00222026-11-20T14:57:49.648361\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022CacheReadInputTokens\u0022:846178,
